
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Johnny904903/p/21635679" title="发布于 2026-07-19 17:45">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ABC20260718E题</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><a href="https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc467/tasks/abc467_e" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">传送门</a></p>
<p>题意：</p>
<ul>
<li>给长度为 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(n-1\)</span> 的序列 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span>，所有元素都在 <span class="math inline">\([0, M-1]\)</span> 内。</li>
<li>一次操作：将 <span class="math inline">\(A_i\)</span> 增加 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>。</li>
<li>目标：满足 <span class="math inline">\((A_i + A_{i+1}) \bmod M = B_i\)</span></li>
<li>求最少操作次数。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p><span class="math inline">\(?\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(!\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(拆拆\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(!\)</span> <span class="math inline">\(?\)</span></p>
<p>设最终数组为 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，则满足 <span class="math inline">\(x_i+x_{i+1}\bmod M=B_i\)</span>。可以发现 <span class="math inline">\(x_1\)</span> 确定则整个序列 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 确定。<br>
<span class="math inline">\(x_2 \equiv B_1-x_1 \pmod M\)</span><br>
<span class="math inline">\(x_3 \equiv B_2-x_2 \equiv B_2-B_1+x_1\pmod M\)</span><br>
<span class="math inline">\(\dots\)</span><br>
<span class="math inline">\(x_n \equiv B_n-B_{n-1}+B_{n-2}-\dots +(-1)^{n+1}B_1\pmod M\)</span></p>
<p>所以设 <span class="math inline">\(s_1=0,s_{i+1}=(B_i-s_i)\bmod M\)</span>(其实这里<span class="math inline">\(s\)</span>就是一个满足条件的<span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>)，<span class="math inline">\(x_i=(s_i+(-1)^{i+1}x_1)\bmod M\)</span></p>
<p>让 <span class="math inline">\(A_i\)</span> 到达 <span class="math inline">\(x_i\)</span> 的最小步数为 <span class="math inline">\((x_i-A_i)\bmod M\)</span>。</p>
<p>我们想求 <span class="math inline">\(f(x_1)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}(x_i-A_i)\bmod M\)</span> 的最小值，设 <span class="math inline">\(v_i=(s_i-A_i)\bmod M\)</span>，考察第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 项</p>
<p>当 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 是奇数是 <span class="math inline">\((v_i+x_1)\bmod M\)</span>，反之为 <span class="math inline">\((v_i-x_1)\bmod M\)</span>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 为奇时 <span class="math inline">\(v_i+x_1-M*[x_1\ge M-v_i]\)</span>，反之为 <span class="math inline">\(v_i-x_1+M*[x1\ge v_i+1]\)</span>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(f\)</span> 就是一个分段函数，那最小值一定是在每一段的分界上，用 map 记录每个临界点计算 <span class="math inline">\(x_1\)</span> 在这个区间的 <span class="math inline">\(f(x_1)\)</span>，开头 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 结尾 <span class="math inline">\(M\)</span> 也计算一遍，取最小。复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n\log n)\)</span>。</p>
<details>
<summary>CODE</summary>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include&lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
using namespace std;
#define rep(i,a,b) for(int i=(a);i&lt;=(b);i++)
#define dwn(i,a,b) for(int i=(a);i&gt;=(b);i--)
const int N=200005;
#define int long long
int a[N],b[N],s[N],v[N],n,m;
map&lt;int,int&gt;mp;
signed main()
{
	cin&gt;&gt;n&gt;&gt;m;
	rep(i,1,n) cin&gt;&gt;a[i];
	rep(i,1,n-1) cin&gt;&gt;b[i];
	rep(i,2,n)
	{
		s[i]=(b[i-1]-s[i-1])%m;
		if(s[i]&lt;0) s[i]+=m;
	}
	int cnt=0,c0=0;
	rep(i,1,n)
	{
		v[i]=(s[i]-a[i])%m;
		if(v[i]&lt;0) v[i]+=m;
		cnt+=v[i];
		if(i&amp;1) ++c0;
		else --c0;
	}
	rep(i,1,n)
		if(i&amp;1)
		{
			int x=(m-1-v[i])%m;
			if(x&lt;=m-2) mp[x]-=m;
		}else if(v[i]&lt;=m-2) mp[v[i]]+=m;
	int ans=cnt,tot=0;
	for(auto&amp;p:mp) tot+=p.second;
	ans=min(ans,cnt+c0*(m-1)+tot);
	int ls=0;
	for(auto&amp;p:mp)
	{
		ls+=p.second;
		ans=min(ans,cnt+c0*(p.first+1)+ls);
	}
	cout&lt;&lt;ans&lt;&lt;'\n';
}
</code></pre>
</details>


</div>
